cost_inputs.basis: infra-only = instance+filesystem; all-in = instance+filesystem+software. Both computed per cell (D7). The Lustre software rate is 0 because the FSx service rate is software-inclusive; the WEKA software rate is the public AWS Marketplace rate, dated like every price.
